title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Neo Tokyo is hiring a Senior Graphic Designer to own its visual identity and every static and digital design asset in-house. That covers social and ad creatives, print, B2B sales collateral, brand identity, and website/UI design.

* **Company:** Neo Tokyo, tech infrastructure (custom PCs, workstations, servers, networking, AMC) for B2C, B2B and Enterprise clients
* **Location:** Kochi, Kerala — full-time, on-site
* **Reports to:** Founder & CEO
* **Works with:** Senior Video Editor (shared brand system), content capture team, Revenue & Growth team (sales collateral and campaigns)
* **Split with the video editor:** the designer owns the brand system and all static/UI design; the editor owns video, motion and thumbnails, built on the designer's templates

Key responsibilities

* **Brand identity** — build and maintain brand guidelines (logo usage, colour, type, tone of visuals) for Neo Tokyo and its sub-brands; keep every output on-brand.
* **Social and ad statics** — design carousels, posters, festive/occasion posts and static ad creatives in every placement size, with variants for A/B testing.
* **Print and collateral** — brochures, product spec sheets, standees, banners, event and showroom signage, packaging inserts and stickers; deliver print-ready files and coordinate with printers.
* **B2B sales collateral** — proposal templates, pitch decks, company profile, case-study layouts and quotation formats for the Revenue & Growth team.
* **Website and UI/UX** — design website pages, landing pages and campaign microsites in Figma; produce wireframes, prototypes and developer-ready handoff; design internal tool screens when needed.
* **Template system** — create reusable templates (social, thumbnails, decks, proposals) so the video editor and sales team produce on-brand work without the designer on every piece.
* **Asset library** — organise and version all source files, brand assets and exports in one shared library.
* **Performance review** — review ad creative and landing-page results with the ads owner and iterate on what converts.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹38,000.00 per month

title: Senior Interior Designer
description:
**SENIOR INTERIOR DESIGNER, 7\+ yrs , Kochi**

**Job Title: SENIOR INTERIOR DESIGNER**

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

A senior interior designer creates and leads design concepts through creative thought processes focused on user experience, materiality, and sustainable approaches, representing the company’s standard design quality. This role will oversee and contribute to the design process from concept to delivery.  
Key Responsibilities:  
 Take a leadership role in the design process, providing guidance and direction to the design team.  
 Lead the development of design concepts, ensuring they align with client objectives, project requirements, and industry trends.  
 Engage with clients to understand their vision, goals, and requirements for the project. Foster strong client relationships, provide exceptional customer service, and present design concepts and recommendations effectively.  
 Oversee multiple projects simultaneously, managing project timelines, budgets, and resources. Coordinate with clients, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.  
 Translate design concepts into detailed plans, elevations, and specifications. Develop comprehensive design packages, including material selections, finishes, lighting plans, and furniture layouts.  
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including architects, engineers, contractors, and consultants. Coordinate and integrate design elements with the architectural and engineering plans, ensuring a cohesive and well\-executed design.  
 Provide guidance and mentorship to junior designers, supporting their professional development and fostering a collaborative and creative work environment. Share industry knowledge, best practices, and design techniques with the team.  
 Source and select vendors, suppliers, and contractors for materials, furniture, and fixtures. Establish and maintain relationships with industry partners, negotiate pricing, and ensure timely delivery of materials and services.  
 Develop project budgets and monitor project expenses throughout the design process. Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising design quality or client satisfaction.  
 Stay informed about the latest trends, innovations, and emerging technologies in interior design. Conduct research on materials, finishes, products, and sustainability practices to enhance design offerings.  
 Prepare and deliver compelling design presentations to clients and stakeholders, utilizing 2D and 3D visualizations, mood boards, and samples to effectively communicate design concepts and solutions.  
 Ensure design integrity and quality by conducting regular site visits and inspections. Review and provide feedback on construction progress, installations, and finished spaces to ensure compliance with design intent.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS  
 A bachelors degree in interior design or a related field is required. Relevant coursework in design principles, space planning, drafting, and CAD software is beneficial.  
 At least 7 years of experience in interior design, with a focus on project leadership and management.  
 Proven ability to lead and inspire a design team, providing guidance, feedback, and mentorship.  
 Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and creatively.  
 Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or other similar tools is essential. Familiarity with graphic design software like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator is a plus.  
 Strong design sensibility and the ability to generate innovative and visually appealing concepts. Knowledge of colour theory, materials, and finishes, as well as an understanding of design principles and aesthetics.  
 Familiarity with local building codes, regulations, and industry standards to ensure compliance in design development and documentation.

title: Interior Designer
description:
**Job Title**: Interior Designer  
**Location**: Kochi, Kerala  
**Company**: BILARA GROUP

**About BILARA GROUP**:  
BILARA GROUP is one of the fastest\-growing construction companies in India, specializing in residential and commercial architectural projects. With a focus on delivering innovative and high\-quality construction and design solutions, we are committed to enhancing the built environment for our clients. We are looking for a creative and skilled Interior Designer to join our team and contribute to transforming spaces with design excellence and functionality.

**Job Overview**

As an Interior Designer at BILARA GROUP, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and executing interior design solutions for a wide range of residential and commercial projects. You will work closely with architects, project managers, and clients to create functional, aesthetic, and innovative interior spaces. Your designs will reflect the brand’s commitment to quality, sustainability, and style while ensuring client satisfaction and project efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design Concept Development**: Develop creative and functional interior design concepts for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects, considering client needs, budget, and space requirements.
* **Space Planning \& Layouts**: Create efficient and aesthetically pleasing floor plans and spatial layouts, optimizing space usage while maintaining a balance between functionality and design.
* **Material Selection \& Sourcing**: Recommend and select materials, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, and color schemes in line with design concepts and project requirements.
* **Client Collaboration**: Liaise with clients to understand their vision, preferences, and functional needs, and translate these into design proposals and presentations.
* **Design Presentations**: Prepare and present design concepts, mood boards, 3D renderings, and other visual tools to clients, effectively communicating the design intent.
* **Project Coordination**: Collaborate with architects, contractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth project execution and timely delivery. Assist with project management tasks, including timelines, budgets, and procurement of materials.
* **Sustainability \& Innovation**: Integrate sustainable design principles into projects, considering energy efficiency, eco\-friendly materials, and responsible design practices.
* **On\-Site Supervision**: Oversee the installation and execution of interior designs on\-site, ensuring the quality and accuracy of implementation. Address any issues or modifications required during the construction phase.
* **Post\-Completion Evaluation**: Conduct final walkthroughs to ensure client satisfaction with the completed interior design. Make adjustments or enhancements where necessary.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or related field.
* Minimum 2\-5 years of experience in interior design, preferably with experience in residential, commercial, and hospitality projects.
* Proficiency in design software, such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3D Max, Revit, Lumion,, Coohom or Adobe Suite.
* Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, and color theory.
* Excellent visual, artistic, and creative skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good understanding of building codes, spatial planning, and design regulations.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, collaborating with other professionals such as architects, contractors, and clients.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with 3D rendering and visualization tools (e.g., V\-Ray, Lumion).
* Familiarity with sustainable design and green building practices.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Knowledge of current interior design trends, materials, and innovations.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work on a variety of exciting residential and commercial projects.
* Professional development and growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding company.
* A creative and collaborative work environment.

**Join BILARA GROUP and help transform spaces with inspiring interior designs that shape the future of architecture and construction!**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* **Experience with marketplace, consumer or two\-sided platforms (strongly preferred)**
* **Expert in Figma, including prototyping, auto\-layout and design systems**
* **Comfortable with user research and usability testing**
* **Understands development constraints and works well with engineers**
* **Thrives in ambiguity and moves fast without losing quality**
* **Ownership mindset: you care about outcomes, not just deliverables**

**Why join**

* **Lead design on a new product from day one**
* **Direct collaboration with the founder**
* **Your work will define the product's look, feel and experience**
* **Early\-stage ownership with room to grow as the team scales**

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**Graphic \& Video Designer Intern**

Evolvx Labs is looking for a **creative, visually driven Graphic \& Video Designer** who can help us build how our products and company are presented to the world.

We build AI products, intelligent business platforms, and automation solutions for real businesses. We are looking for someone who can take our products, ideas, features, and stories and turn them into **engaging videos, social media content, product visuals, presentations, and marketing creatives.**

This is not a traditional video editing role. We want someone who can **think creatively, understand what makes content interesting, and contribute ideas that help us market our products.**

If you enjoy creating content, experimenting with visual styles, understanding social media trends, and turning complex technology into content people can understand and remember, this role is for you.

The Role

As a Creative Content \& Video Designer, you will work closely with the founding team to create the visual content and marketing material used to communicate our products and brand.

You will be involved from **idea to execution**, including deciding how a product should be presented, creating the concept, editing the content, and refining it based on audience response.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Marketing Content**  
Understand our products and turn their features, benefits, and use cases into engaging content that helps attract customers and generate interest.

**Video \& Content Creation**  
Create product videos, promotional videos, Reels, Shorts, explainers, advertisements, company videos, and other marketing content.

**Creative Storytelling**  
Develop creative ways to communicate complex AI and technology concepts in a simple, engaging, and visually interesting way.

**Social Media Content**  
Create content for platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube, including short\-form videos, carousels, product showcases, and other creative formats.

**Visual Brand Building**  
Help develop and maintain the visual identity of Evolvx Labs and its products across social media, websites, presentations, advertisements, and marketing materials.

**Creative Concepts**  
Come up with ideas for campaigns, videos, product launches, advertisements, visual concepts, and social media content rather than simply waiting for instructions.

**Video Editing \& Motion Design**  
Edit footage and create motion graphics, animations, transitions, typography, visual effects, and other elements required to make content engaging.

**Product Understanding**  
Work closely with the founding team to understand what we are building and identify interesting stories, features, and use cases that can be turned into marketing content.

**Content Experimentation**  
Experiment with different hooks, formats, editing styles, visual concepts, storytelling approaches, and trends to improve content performance.

**Trend Research**  
Stay updated with social media trends, creative formats, AI\-generated content, advertising styles, and emerging visual trends.

**Creative Collaboration**  
Work directly with the founding team to brainstorm, execute, review, and improve creative content.

What We're Looking ForCreativity

Someone who naturally thinks visually and creatively and enjoys coming up with new ideas rather than simply following instructions.

Video Editing

Good understanding of video editing, pacing, music, sound design, transitions, typography, storytelling, and visual composition.

Design Sense

Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, layouts, color, composition, and modern digital aesthetics.

Marketing Mindset

Ability to think beyond "Does this video look good?" and ask **"Will this make someone interested in our product?"**

Social Media Understanding

Good understanding of what makes content engaging on platforms such as Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Tools

Experience with tools such as **Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar creative tools**.

AI \& New Tools

Interest in experimenting with AI\-powered creative tools for video generation, image generation, animation, voice, and content creation.

Ownership

You should be comfortable taking an idea from concept to final output and proactively suggesting improvements along the way.

Portfolio

A portfolio of videos, social media content, designs, advertisements, or other creative work is strongly preferred.

**We care more about your creativity and what you can create than your degree or qualification.**

Why Join Us?Build a Brand From the Early Stage

You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how Evolvx Labs and its products are presented to the market.

Creative Freedom

You won't be restricted to a fixed editing template. We want you to experiment, suggest ideas, and develop your own creative style.

Work Directly With the Founding Team

You'll work closely with the founders and have direct exposure to product development, marketing, and business strategy.

AI \+ Creativity

Work at the intersection of AI, technology, design, video, and marketing while experimenting with some of the latest creative tools.

Real Product Exposure

Create content for actual AI products and enterprise solutions rather than generic marketing assignments.

Startup Environment

Fast\-paced, execution\-driven environment where your ideas can quickly become real campaigns, content, and product launches.

**Work Location: KOCHI**

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a fast\-growing Global SaaS / Software Product company building cutting\-edge solutions in education and faith\-based technologies. Eloit is on a mission to unlock potential through graceful innovation. Our flagship platforms include Edisapp School ERP, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and more, headquartered in London, with over a decade of innovation and operations in Kochi, India.

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for a talented and creative UI Developer with a strong eye for design and a passion for building intuitive, engaging, and user\-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile platforms.

The ideal candidate will combine strong UI/UX design skills with hands\-on frontend development expertise, particularly in Vue.js, to transform user and business requirements into high\-quality digital products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop intuitive, responsive, and visually engaging user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Translate business and user requirements into user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Develop user\-facing applications and reusable UI components using Vue.js.
* Create and maintain design systems, style guides, UI patterns, and reusable design components to ensure consistency across products.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Convert functional requirements and user needs into simple, effective, and aesthetically appealing user experiences.
* Identify, analyse, and resolve UI/UX usability issues through research, testing, and iterative design.
* Create original visual assets, graphics, icons, and other UI elements when required.
* Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, scalable, and optimized for different screen sizes and devices.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and maintain visual consistency between design and production.
* Conduct design reviews and provide guidance on UI/UX best practices.
* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions, workflows, components, and interaction patterns.
* Stay updated with emerging UI/UX trends, frontend technologies, accessibility standards, and design methodologies.

Design and develop UI flows, menus, HUDs, and user\-facing applications that meet defined design goals; create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and supporting documentation; translate business and user requirements into style guides, design systems, design patterns, and attractive, consistent user interfaces; develop and maintain responsive user\-facing applications using Vue.js; create original graphic designs and visual assets where required; and identify, analyse, and troubleshoot UX and usability problems through iterative design and testing.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* Required Skills \& Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in UI development, UI/UX design, frontend development, or a related role.
* Strong proficiency in modern UI/UX design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with Vue.js and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Good understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, interaction design, and usability.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of responsive web and mobile design principles.
* Ability to translate designs into functional, production\-ready interfaces.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.
* Experience with mobile UI/UX design and mobile\-first design principles.
* Understanding of accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design.
* Experience working with design tokens and component libraries.
* Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience in designing products for education, ERP, SaaS, or enterprise applications.

**What We Value**

* A strong user\-first mindset.
* Creativity combined with practical problem\-solving.
* Ability to balance design quality, usability, and technical feasibility.
* Ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and experiment with new technologies and design approaches.

**Why Eloit?**

At Eloit, you will not just be doing a job; you will be part of a mission. We build technology that impacts thousands of schools, students, and faith communities across the globe, and every person on our team plays a real role in that story.

We are a decade\-old, London\-headquartered Global SaaS / Software Product company with a passionate team in Kochi, India, building world\-class platforms trusted by 700\+ institutions across 4 continents. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we invest in the people who make it happen.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture
